svg.title: Attestara
svg.desc: Local CLI + browser viewer. A local release-evidence CLI that checks manifests, file bytes and SBOMs, evaluates the evidence-presence rule, and assesses signatures against independently configured trust. The browser viewer inspects passport claims; verification runs in the Linux CLI.

g.data-label: Keep the bytes, the policy and the signer separate.
A local release-evidence CLI that checks manifests, file bytes and SBOMs, evaluates the
evidence-presence rule, and assesses signatures against independently configured trust.
The browser viewer inspects passport claims; verification runs in the Linux CLI.
